description: 三位诺恩之一，与乌尔德、斯库尔德共同参与命运秩序。
fullDescription: 来源明确她是三位被点名的诺恩之一，但没有规定现代意义上的‘现在女神’外观。设计上可用正在流动的水纹、线性手势与更开放的姿态表达进行中的状态，但不采用发光时间线。
roleInSeries: 完成命运三人组的中间视觉节奏。

sourceRefs.note: 点名三位诺恩并描述其命运职能。

visualThesis: 更流动、更开放的诺恩形象，以泉水涟漪和连续动作表达生成感。

interpretationNotes: Verðandi=现在是常见解释而非本节显式外观事实

instructions: 脸型、发型和身体姿态必须与Urðr和Skuld明显不同
用真实水纹/手势替代抽象魔法线

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、手、近身水纹高细节；背景柔化。
visual.subjectSeparation: 流动边缘与静态背景形成分离。

prompt.draft: Create Verðandi as a distinct Norn beside the world-tree spring. Use a flowing, open posture and natural water ripples or continuous hand movement to suggest ongoing becoming, without literal clocks, laser lines or sci-fi time UI. She must have a clearly different face, hairstyle and silhouette from Urðr and Skuld. Keep the visual language natural and restrained, with face and hands in the crop-safe upper-middle area. Background soft, spring/root context secondary.
prompt.final:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Asset type: MythCanvas Norse M01 collectible-card source artwork.

Create ONE standalone portrait 9:16 pure artwork for card 1003010010, Verðandi / 薇尔丹蒂, type character.

This is an original mythological interpretation, not a copy of a modern franchise design.

The image must contain no typography, title, logo, card frame, number, watermark, pseudo-runes, UI, collage, split layout, contact sheet, or panels.

Content brief: Create Verðandi as a distinct Norn beside the world-tree spring. Use a flowing, open posture and natural water ripples or continuous hand movement to suggest ongoing becoming, without literal clocks, laser lines or sci-fi time UI. She must have a clearly different face, hairstyle and silhouette from Urðr and Skuld. Keep the visual language natural and restrained, with face and hands in the crop-safe upper-middle area. Background soft, spring/root context secondary.

Visual thesis: 更流动、更开放的诺恩形象，以泉水涟漪和连续动作表达生成感。

Identity anchors: 流动姿态；泉水涟漪；独立脸型；中等动态

Must keep: 比Urðr更动态；比Skuld更柔和；同组材质不同构图

Must avoid: 复制Urðr脸；复制Skuld脸；发光时间线；魔法激光；科幻UI

Composition: camera eye level; shot standing or kneeling flowing three-quarter; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 青灰；水蓝；骨白；柔绿; materials 泉水；湿石；粗织物；树根; mood flowing；present-tense；quiet；restrained.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010009；1003010011. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: Urðr clone；Skuld clone；magic laser lines；clock；sci-fi UI；crystal ball；glossy game-CG；typography; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
prompt.notes: 用自然连续运动表达差异，不用魔法特效表达抽象概念。

references.notes: 生成前必须查看相关已批准角色，继承系列画风但避免复制脸型、体量、姿态和环境模板。
